Access to the gated DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 encoder and FLUX.2-dev VAE is also required and their weights are not included here. The OpenCore IDOL image-to-3D Gaussian pipeline is not integrated or inference-verified.

models.label: Vortecks LFM3 1.7B Heretic Abliterated
models.description: Exact Vortecks Heretic-abliterated edition with all 25 published GGUF files, from experimental low-bit formats to BF16, F16 and F32. The pinned LFM3 engine prepares automatically; actual text generation must pass after installation. Published 256K context metadata is a capacity, not a long-context quality test.

models.label: mondk LFM3 1.7B Claude Code
models.description: Exact mondk tool-use and coding fine-tune, published as one Q8_0 GGUF. It is a local LFM3 derivative, not an Anthropic model or hosted Claude service. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine with verification after installation; publisher benchmark results are not OpenCore tests.

models.label: LFM3 1.7B LiteRT
models.description: Exact LiteRT-LM conversion with two weight precisions, INT8 and mixed INT4/INT8, each published with a 2048- or 4096-token cache. Each bundle embeds its tokenizer and modified chat template. These are .litertlm packages, requiring a real Android LiteRT-LM adapter; they cannot load in llama.cpp. No NPU package is published.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires a real Android LiteRT-LM 0.18.1-compatible adapter with a separate Engine per conversation and the bundled template/state handling. OpenCore has no integrated verified LiteRT-LM runner. This .litertlm package cannot load in llama.cpp; context is limited to its published 2048 or 4096 tokens.

models.label: Guilherme34 LFM3 Looped HiddenCoT
models.description: Exact research edition with structural changes and a latent-token thinking prefix, published as Q6_K and Q8_0 GGUF. Includes the publisher-required external chat_template, which differs from the embedded GGUF template. Its reported behavior and quality remain unverified in OpenCore.

sources.runtimeReason: Requires the LFM3 runtime plus explicit selection of the pinned external chat_template and its latent-token prefix. The current OpenCore runner uses the embedded template and has no external-template selection hook; correct Looped HiddenCoT inference is not yet verified.

models.label: mohommed LFM3 Frontier SmartAgent v4
models.description: Exact Frontier SmartAgent v4 SDT/SimPO edition with all three published Q4_K_M, Q4_K_S and Q8_0 GGUFs. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine and verifies actual generation after installation. The files declare 524288-token context; the publisher extension and quality claims have not been independently evaluated by OpenCore.

models.label: Kaitchup LFM3 1.7B SLQ
models.description: Exact EAR97.7 SLQ checkpoint: one mixed-precision GGUF with Q6_K as its dominant-family label, not an ordinary uniform Q6_K quant. The publisher EAR value measures calibration probability overlap, not benchmark accuracy or statistical equivalence. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine; generation is checked after installation.

models.label: orcarouter LFM3 1.7B Abliterated
models.description: Exact gated orcarouter abliterated checkpoint. Public publisher metadata identifies one BF16 safetensors model and the Lfm3ForCausalLM custom-code architecture. Publisher access is required for the files; no GGUF or additional quantization is published in this repository. OpenCore does not automatically execute repository code.

sources.runtimeReason: This publisher checkpoint is gated and declares custom Lfm3 Python code. Approved Hugging Face access and a separately reviewed compatible LFM3 Transformers adapter are required; OpenCore does not execute repository code automatically. No actual generation has been verified.

models.label: AtomicChat LFM3 1.7B Uncensored
models.description: Exact AtomicChat safety-ablated edition with both published AD-Q4_K_M and AD-Q6_K GGUFs. The ablation is baked into these weights, keeping this edition distinct from the base model and other publishers. Uses the pinned LFM3 engine; publisher quality claims are not OpenCore runtime tests.

models.label: Morphy 1.1 Coder Beta 7B
models.description: Publisher beta coding model. The exact repository currently publishes one Q8_0 GGUF. Its GGUF metadata reports a 32,768-token context; the publisher Modelfile defaults to 8,192. Runtime preparation and real generation must pass after installation.

models.label: TwIL-8B
models.description: Granite-based reasoning model in balanced and verbose editions. Non-commercial publisher license applies. Runtime compatibility and a real generation must be verified after installation.
